notes.title: ANOTHER UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hi guys!
We just released a new update which solves the following issues!

- The bug where it was impossible to shoot zombies that get very close to you has been fixed! Now zombies that get very close to you can be shot.

- The bug that prevents players from being able to shoot after using too much melee consecutively has been fixed!

- The issue where friendly NPCs get in your way or block your path has been rectified!
Now you can easily push them out of the way.

- Melee damage has been doubled!
one melee hit is now enough to kill any regular zombie (This is very useful when you are surrounded by zombies)

We will continue to listen out for bug reports and do our best to fix them as soon as possible.

Thanks

notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hi guys
We have just released a new update to enable changing of weapons and using of health meds without having to open the inventory first. 
Now new buttons have been assigned to make switching and using health meds fast.

Key [1] - Equips Weapon 1
Key [2] - Equips Weapon 2
Key [3] - Equips Weapon 3
Key [Q] - Uses Health Med

We apologise for the inconvenience of not having this feature before might have caused.
Thank you.
